_comment: Attribution for the third-party material the benchmark data is derived from.

`papers`: JMLR. Every record was read from the published PDF's page-1 footer. Volume 18 (2017) onward is CC-BY 4.0; earlier volumes state no public licence, and those 4 papers' text is rewritten in our own words.
`iclr`: ICLR papers on OpenReview under CC-BY 4.0. Each `key` is the OpenReview forum id and the item id in backward-verification.jsonl; the forum page carries the title, authors and licence.
`lecture_sources`: lecture notes and textbooks, each publicly available or used with the permission of its authors.
Our own contributions (Lean statements and proofs, labels, annotations, text we wrote) are CC BY 4.0, see Benchmarks/LICENSE.
